fact: Communications and IT Minister Raafat Hindy said the state has connected government bodies through the Government Digital Transformer, allowing real-time, secure data exchange with more than 100 government databases.
Minister Hindy said 105 government bodies are connected through the Government Digital Transformer, with integration to more than 100 government databases.
The ICT minister told a cabinet meeting that under the government digital switch project 105 government bodies have been linked, allowing secure data exchange between them.
The ICT minister said 105 government bodies are linked through the government digital switch project, and 100 national databases have been linked under a data integration system in development.
